selectionHint: Choose each answer yourself. Unanswered questions have no score, including no default score of 5.
notesHint: Optional, up to 5,000 characters. You can leave this blank.
previewTitle: Content to send to the AI
previewHint: These are your current answers and attachment choice. Changing an answer, the history choice or the language requires a new consent check.
historyIncluded: Include records from the last 7 days
requiredHint: Choose all three answers and review the AI notice before sending. You can leave this page at any time.
send: Send these answers to the AI
sendHint: Only this button sends your answers. Pressing Enter or returning to this page does not send anything. Consent applies to one request.
waitingHint: Your submitted answers are fixed while this request is processing. You can switch pages and return during this login session.
submittedContent: Review the answers submitted in this request
failed: The AI response could not be received
unconfirmed: The outcome of the AI request could not be confirmed
failureHint: Your answers remain here. No new health assessment has been made. Review the submitted answers below before preparing another request. Sending again creates a new AI request and requires fresh consent; it does not restore the previous response.
unconfirmedHint: The previous request may already have reached the service and may still finish. Sending again does not cancel it. This screen cannot retrieve the response from that request.
prepareRetry: Bring the submitted answers back for review
replaceRetryConfirm: Replace your current answers and history choice with those from the failed request? The current response language stays the same. You will review the content and consent again before sending.
replaceUnread: Send a new request before reading the previous response? If a new response arrives, it will replace the previous response and its submitted answers on this screen. Cancel to read it first.
previousResult: This is the earlier response, not the result of the request above.
differentInput: This response relates to the submitted answers below. Your current form has different answers or choices.
clearConfirm: Clear the current answers and AI consent? The response already shown below will remain associated with its submitted answers.
sessionHint: These answers and responses stay in this login session when switching pages. Refreshing or signing out may clear them. This feature does not add a mood tracking record.
resultWork: A reflection response is ready to read
